name: unreal-render
description: Two skills. unreal-render: build and render Unreal Engine 5 scenes headless on a Windows GPU PC over SSH (Python-scripted levels, Fab and sample content, Cesium tiles, Movie Render Queue frames, a camera track for the web). unreal-city: build a real city by script from OpenStreetMap and a sample project's buildings, light it for night, and review every frame against real photographs.
